# CMJani

> CMJani is the website of Jani, a Finnish special correspondent for Southeast Asia with 20 years of experience, also known as Chiang Mai Jani. Each page covers one YouTube video: the places in it, with addresses and Google Maps links, plus first-hand notes on routes, food and travel. Finnish is the default language, and each page also exists in English.

Key facts:

- YouTube channel: CMJani, https://www.youtube.com/@ChiangMaiJani
- Topics: Chiang Mai, Thailand, Southeast Asia travel, hiking, motorbike trips and food
- Languages: Finnish at the site root, English under /en/
- Prices, opening hours and routes can change. Each post shows the date its details were checked.

## Posts in English

- [Easy or insane? Hiking Monk's Trail and Doi Pui in Chiang Mai](https://cmjani.pages.dev/en/hiking-chiang-mai-monks-trail-doi-pui/): two hikes in Doi Suthep–Pui National Park with measured distance, ascent and time, entrance fees and the best season
- [Khao soi in Chiang Mai: three restaurants put to the test](https://cmjani.pages.dev/en/khao-soi-chiang-mai-three-restaurants/): Khao Soi Maesai, Khao Soi Mae Manee 2 and Khao-Sō-i compared, with addresses

## Posts in Finnish

- [Viidakko ja vuorenhuippu: Monk's Trail ja Doi Pui Chiang Maissa](https://cmjani.pages.dev/patikointi-chiang-mai-monks-trail-doi-pui/): kaksi patikointireittiä, mittaukset, pääsymaksut ja paras sesonki
- [Khao Soi Chiang Maissa: kolme ravintolaa testissä](https://cmjani.pages.dev/khao-soi-chiang-mai-kolme-ravintolaa/): kolmen Khao Soi -ravintolan vertailu ja osoitteet
